scope: Candidate B complete bounded code-area review at exact supplied source hashes; standard-library worker-host API, Go 1.22 minimum.

coverage.reason: Applicable: the host-supplied Lease protocol, injected Open dependency, cancellation/error propagation and cohort ownership are design boundaries; reviewed API, ownership and composition without demanding another framework.
Applicable: reviewed local state transitions, result collection, checked errors, context guards, docs, value/closure semantics under go 1.22; gofmt and vet independently executed.

Applicable: reviewed every README result/lifecycle obligation, API shape, empty/finite/open input, partial acquisition, all three failure stages, cancellation before/during/stopping, successful effects and supported Go minimum.

Applicable: reviewed candidate host_test.go assertions, doubles, event gates, cleanup and whether meaningful contract violations evade its authored suite. External held/supplementary/independent probes verify behavior; they are not additions to the candidate regression suite.

Not applicable within this bounded trusted-host API: Job is a caller-supplied integer; Open and Lease are trusted collaborators; there is no demonstrated attacker, authorization boundary, sensitive sink, credential, cryptographic or network/file parsing decision. General resource failures are not recast as vulnerabilities. No advisory scan or security assessment of an unspecified host is claimed.

Applicable: cancellation, stop propagation, failure containment, joining actual cleanup and errors.Is diagnostics are the available library signals. No service telemetry, retries or arbitrary timeout requirement is inferred.

Applicable: limit bounds acquired leases through Close, cohort completion controls goroutines/resources, and available capacity must be used. Assessed scaling/lifetime and bounded event counts; no microbenchmark or production latency claim.

Applicable: go.mod declares Go 1.22 and standard-library-only production/tests. Verified standalone readonly resolution, host and actual minimum compilation/test execution, imports, module graph and exact input hashes. No generated/native/release inputs or bit-identical artifact contract.

Not applicable to the bounded library code area: no configured release artifact, CI/promotion path, process signals, container, runtime configuration, health/routing or grace budget decision is supplied or promised. Host deployment evidence is unavailable outside scope and excluded, not reported as passing. Library lifecycle is assessed by the applicable topics.

findings.cause: Run errors cannot request stop while the controller is admitting input or blocked in synchronous Open.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host.go:39; candidates/B/host.go:48; candidates/B/host.go:61; candidates/B/host.go:86; evidence/B-host-contract.log: TestReviewRunFailureCancelsPendingOpen requires caller cancellation; evidence/B-minimum-contract.log: same intended assertion; evidence/B-host-race.log: repeated behavioral failure; The first Run returns its independent error while Open 2 cooperatively waits for work context stop. The error remains buffered until admission completes, so Serve retains its owned lease indefinitely without a caller cancel. This is a contained important liveness/stop contract failure.
findings.correction: Let a failing Run cancel the cohort immediately, or observe Run outcomes concurrently with pending Open while collecting its returned ownership.

findings.cause: Close errors never set failed, so the outer loop admits another cohort after observed Close failure.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host.go:99; candidates/B/host.go:105; evidence/B-host-independent.log: three opens/closes at limit 1 after first Close failure; evidence/B-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertion; Three valid jobs are acquired instead of stopping after the first failing Close, while the error remains inspectable. Material admission contract break is confined to Serve.
findings.correction: Mark failure/stop on Close error and finish all releases before returning.

findings.cause: Open success launches Run unconditionally without checking cancellation that occurred inside Open.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host.go:57; candidates/B/host.go:59; evidence/B-host-independent.log: TestIndependentAcquiredAfterCancelSkipsRun observes runs=1; evidence/B-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertion; evidence/B-host-race.log: repeated forbidden Run; A lease returned successfully after callback cancellation still runs once; the fixture policy explicitly requires ownership/release with no Run. Contained important startup/stop contract break.
findings.correction: Append the acquired lease, recheck cohort/caller stop, and skip Run while retaining the lease for release.

findings.cause: Authored Run failure fixtures only observe failure after admission can finish, leaving pending-Open stop unverified.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host_test.go:111; candidates/B/host_test.go:145; evidence/B-host-authored.log: suite passes P1; evidence/B-host-contract.log: independently executed pending-Open assertion fails; An important failure-containment/liveness contract is not detected: the cooperating pending Open needs caller cancellation despite Run failure.
findings.correction: Add a pending cooperative Open gated against a failing prior Run; assert it receives stop and Serve completes without caller cancel.

findings.cause: The Close-only regression case closes input after one job, so it cannot detect renewed admission after Close failure.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host_test.go:258; evidence/B-host-authored.log: suite passes P2; evidence/B-host-independent.log: Close-only queued-job assertion fails; The important stop-after-Close-failure contract remains unverified independently of error identity.
findings.correction: Keep later jobs queued after the failing Close and assert one acquisition/release at limit 1.

findings.cause: The acquired-but-not-started test neither establishes a stop during Open nor checks zero Runs; it explicitly expects the second Run to start.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host_test.go:225; candidates/B/host_test.go:253; candidates/B/host_test.go:253 checks startedSecond.Load()!=1; evidence/B-host-authored.log: suite passes P3; evidence/B-host-independent.log: cancellation-before-success observes forbidden Run; The test name suggests a crucial ownership transition is protected, but the actual fixture allows the broken transition and checks only a normally started second Run.
findings.correction: Add an Open callback that cancels before returning success; assert zero second Runs and release of every acquired lease after joining existing Runs.

strengths.evidence: The exact Job/Lease/Serve API remains compatible and construction stays host-owned through the Open function, with no unrelated framework/public API; both actual toolchains compile every source package.

Actual go1.22.12 and go1.26.5 compile the standalone go 1.22 standard-library-only module with GOWORK=off, GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly; go list -m all returns only example.com/service-owned-workers. No external go.sum is needed.
